name: MindLoom WhatsApp
description: Forwards inbound WhatsApp messages to MindLoom so they become searchable there. Read-only: OpenClaw never replies on WhatsApp while this is enabled.

apiUrl.description: MindLoom API base URL, e.g. https://api.mindloom.example

token.description: WhatsApp link token from MindLoom (starts with mlwa_).

silent.description: Stop the OpenClaw agent from replying to WhatsApp messages.
